description: C1 authentication and credential inventory contracts - read-only probes against both hosts.

cases.name: C1 credential inventory and per-workflow credential map parity
cases.notes: GET /api/v1/credentials on both hosts: every n8n credential (name, type) must exist on m9m, and the per-node credential map of every shared workflow must match. m9m-only credentials are reported but not treated as drift, because the shared instance hosts extra local credentials.

cases.name: C1 m9m API requires a key while n8n rejects anonymous API calls
cases.notes: Read-only GET probes. m9m is closed by default: every /api/v1 path answers 401 without a credential, /healthz stays public, and the configured X-API-Key is accepted. The n8n key goes to n8n only; the m9m key goes to m9m only.
